answer: New identities are priced on the registry's plume curve: the k-th identity funded from one wallet pays k times the base fee of 50 POA, so one honest user pays 50 POA once while 1,000 puppets from one wallet cost 50 × (1+…+1000) = 25,025,000 POA. Fresh wallets do not help: the registry traces funding through its karst graph, where pooled money seeps through branching channels to surface as one cluster, and the trellis prices the cluster as one. Each puppet is billed separately, no bulk discount, so cost grows quadratically with N while one honest user pays the base fee once.
